ns2:course.label: Exploring Visual Culture
ns2:course.description: Introduces key concepts for understanding the wide range of imagery that has come to characterize contemporary everyday life in the 21st century. Explores concepts drawn from the literature of visual culture studies. Analyzes images from popular culture, fine arts, and vernacular arts, with contemporary mass media, such as music videos and television dramas, being considered alongside historical paintings and sculpture.
